column1: # p0521: phases already over a name or goal bound when the rule was installed.
# From here a listed phase may only get SHORTER, a new phase may not join, and a phase
# that now fits must LEAVE this list — the test fails either way. Every row is in done/,
# which is not edited: the file name of a done phase is a pointer the record carries.
#   slug         file-name tail over 50 characters (date-minted namespace)
#   schema-goal  goal over the embedded schema's own 2000, which the whole-file check reads
